# Kumud Waykole

> Kumud Waykole is a Full Stack Software Developer with 3+ years of experience building production web applications with React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript and PostgreSQL. Focus areas: system design, database architecture, performance optimization and DevOps. Currently at SourceCatch Konnect.

## Role

Software Engineer / Full Stack Software Developer (frontend, backend, database and deployment), 3+ years of experience.

## Technical skills

- Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP
- Backend: Node.js, Express, REST APIs, Medusa.js, Zod
- Databases & ORM: PostgreSQL, Prisma, Redis
- Payments: Razorpay, Stripe
- DevOps & tooling: Docker, GitHub Actions, CI/CD, Turborepo, Git, pnpm, Vercel, Jest
- Architecture: System design, software architecture, database optimization, performance optimization, monorepo architecture
